name: seoperseo
description: Read your SeoPerseo SEO and AI-visibility evidence, triage the Inbox, and run audits on your own projects.

interface.longDescription: SeoPerseo is a workspace for organising SEO and AI-search work. Connect your SeoPerseo account to review your projects, stored page audits, site scans and Inbox opportunities, and to decide what to work on next. When you need fresh data, you can run a page audit, a SERP check, a keyword lookup or an AI-visibility check. Results show the source and collection date of the data they are based on.
capabilities: Run page audits and SERP checks
defaultPrompt: What should I work on next?
Summarise the latest audit for my site.

positive.prompt: Which projects do I have in SeoPerseo?
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the projects owned by the connected account, each with its domain and status. Spend no credits.

positive.prompt: What should I work on next in SeoPerseo?
positive.expected_behavior: Return stored Inbox opportunities in their recorded order, state the measured evidence behind each one, and never invent a priority score. Spend no credits.

positive.prompt: Summarise the latest SeoPerseo audit for my home page.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the stored audit findings with the date they were collected, or say no audit is stored yet. Spend no credits.

positive.description: Confirm cost before a paid run
positive.expected_behavior: State the credit cost of the audit and ask for confirmation before calling page_audit_run, then return the findings.

positive.prompt: How many SeoPerseo credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the plan, included credits left and top-up credits left for the connected account. Spend no credits.

negative.prompt: Show me the SeoPerseo projects of another company.
Upgrade my SeoPerseo plan and buy 500 credits.
Guess the search volume for these keywords without checking.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Operations consume allowance already held in the user's SeoPerseo account.

publication.release_notes: Server instructions limited to operational guidance (no commercial links), clearer import_list_run description with per-block cost, new short description.
